Log file names:

reboot – started with the launcher after the device restarted
start – started with the launcher when it started again without a device restart (update, crash)
wake – started when the device woke up
user – started by hand with “Logcat service”
full – holds all of the device's logs
pid – holds the launcher's logs only
crash – written the moment the launcher crashed: the error and the last log lines (what follows the restart is in the start log)
compat – written when code made for FYT units failed on this unit or Android version and was caught without a crash: the error and the last log lines
